_doc: Expected shortcut renderer output, indexed by profile id. Generated FROM the JS reference resolver (desktop/shared/spa/js/fixture_shortcuts.js) — regenerate from it, never by hand. All three twins must produce these exact `id` lists in this exact order for the corresponding profile: the JS resolver (gated by tests/test_fixture_shortcuts.py via Node), the Kotlin twin (android/.../shortcuts/FixtureShortcuts.kt, gated by android/app/src/test/.../FixtureShortcutsTest.kt via gradlew test), and the Swift twin (ios/SlyLED/UI/Components/FixtureShortcuts.swift, gated by ios/SlyLEDTests/FixtureShortcutsTests.swift via the SlyLEDTests XCTest target). Corpus coverage (#906): explicit `shortcut` annotations (hurricane), the capability-type heuristic pass incl. a ShutterStrobe channel with no Strobe range (hazer ch4 — must NOT emit), the name-match fallback pass incl. an ineligible macro-type channel whose name matches (hazer ch3 — must NOT emit), the color-swatch red/green/blue channel_map gate (mover — red+green annotated but no blue channel, swatch dropped), and swatch anchoring/uv pickup (hurricane, wash).
